meta_reflection: The milestone completed 8 compute-bound tasks in 10.6 wall-time minutes, with execution concentrated in causal history support measurement (4.53 minutes), private ARC output placement repair (2.31 minutes), and durable Rust service consumer shipping (2.28 minutes). The post-run GPU monitor report confirms an idle llama.cpp process on GPU 0 after completion but cannot evaluate active-window compute efficiency, and because only single-model tasks were executed, no DualGPURunner multi-model dispatch opportunity was missed.
